RC1_CANONICAL_IDENTITY.invariant: All managers normalize to one surface/source/digest identity.

RC2_EVIDENCE_FRESHNESS.invariant: Scan/cache evidence binds digest, policy, DB revision and TTL.

RC3_EXCEPTION_ORDER_SCOPE.invariant: Exceptions are exact-scope, current, and cannot bypass prerequisite gates.

RC4_PERMIT_AUTH_SCOPE.invariant: Permits are keyed, expiring, and bind exact decision scope.

RC5_AUDIT_DURABILITY.invariant: Every decision is journaled and fsynced before completion.

RC6_RECOVERY_CONCURRENCY.invariant: Recovery/concurrency never exposes partial or inconsistent decision state.
